title: Open mic answers mid-sentence: hold segments ~2.5s of quiet then post one joined prompt; card assistant waits on unfinished words.

set.request: Open mic answers mid-sentence: hold segments ~2.5s of quiet then post one joined prompt; card assistant waits on unfinished words.
set.outcome: **Open mic now waits for a pause** — ai2 compose.js holds finished segments and posts one joined prompt after 2.5 s of quiet (flushes on stop); card-assistant.md gained a rule to stay silent on cut-off words (needs a Servex restart). Servex Layers.js listen() has a 4 s delay of its own, so mastermind-servex decides whether compose.js stays.
